_comment_interpolation: Values below use plain ${VAR}. Do NOT write ${VAR:-default}.
FastMCP's interpolation is re.sub(r'\$\{([^}]+)\}', ...) and looks up
the whole capture as an environment variable name, so ${VAR:-default}
searches for a variable literally named 'VAR:-default'. That never
exists, so the placeholder survives even when VAR itself IS set --
silently disabling the setting. There is no default syntax; defaults
belong in signalhire_mcp.config.Settings, and an unset variable arrives
as its own name, which Settings reads as empty.
